decisions.boundary_condition: Applies only to flight departure time-of-day. Do not infer it for arrival times, dates, routes, every leg automatically, or earliest-afternoon departures as a recurring rule.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefers afternoon flight departures as a soft default when no different departure-time constraint is specified.
decisions.condition: When selecting or comparing flight departure times.
decisions.default_action: Look first for departure options in the afternoon; follow any current explicit request for another time window or exact time.
decisions.exception_condition: If acceptable afternoon departures are unavailable or conflict with other stated constraints, ask before broadening to nearby time windows.
decisions.name: prefers_afternoon_departures
decisions.preference_value: Prefers flight departures in the afternoon when no different departure-time constraint is specified.
decisions.rationale: Multiple examples across separate conversations show the user asking for afternoon flight departures. Keep as a soft departure-time default, limited to flight departure time and overridden by any explicit current constraint.
